{{Tabs|Gallery}} ==Upgrade Icons== {{UpgradeIcons |[[File:HallowPunkUpgrade1.png|150px]] |[[File:HallowPunkUpgrade2.png|150px]] |[[File:HallowPunkMaxUpgrade.png|150px]] }} ==Skin Upgrades== The '''Hallow Punk''' has two skins in total. #The Default skin. #One skin unlocked from [[Crates]]. {{Tabber |Default |{{SkinGallery |Title1 = Default |Icon1 = [[File:DefaultHallowPunkIconIG.png|128px]] |[[File:DefaultHallowPunk0.png|200px]] |Tan skin, messy blonde hair, black shirt sleeves and hat, red shorts, socks and boots, black jacket tied around waist, grey chestplate and singular knee-pad on left leg, orange goggles and bulky black backpack. Extra optic on goggles. |[[File:DefaultHallowPunk2.png|200px]] |Spiked shoulder pads, gloves, and hat. Black and orange covering draped over legs. Rockets have a face. |[[File:DefaultHallowPunk3.png|200px]] |Pocket straps around left leg, armor plates on boots, smokey grey antlers, dark green chestplate and bigger backpack. Orange pallet switches to red. Now wields a red and black rocket launcher. }} |Lunar |The {{Color|LunarYear|Lunar}} skin is obtained from the [[Lunar Crate|{{Color|LunarYear|Lunar Crate}}]]. Extended black and yellow sleeves with a small green orb. |[[File:ChineseNYHallowPunk2.png|200px]] |Lighter red sleeve outlines. Red design around waist. Barrel is now open and is filled with food.
